checks.claim: A committed contract file is the source of truth and the implementation is validated against it.
checks.evidence_required: The contract file path in git plus a conformance or generated-type check that would catch drift.
checks.how_to_run: git ls-files for the contract; run the contract/conformance test and quote the exit code.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: A committed contract file exists and is the source of truth

checks.claim: Every request is validated against the schema at the boundary; invalid input gets a clear 4xx with a consistent error envelope.
checks.evidence_required: Test output for an invalid body, param and query returning 4xx with the shared envelope.
checks.how_to_run: Run the validation-failure tests and quote them.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Every request is validated against the schema at the boundary

checks.claim: Auth is enforced server-side on every protected route, deny-by-default, proven by a negative test.
checks.evidence_required: A test where an unauthenticated and a wrong-scope request get 401/403.
checks.how_to_run: Run the auth negative tests and quote the 401/403 assertions.
checks.honesty_note: Never record "auth enforced" without the negative test output.

source.quote: a negative (unauthenticated / wrong-scope) test proves rejection

checks.claim: Explicit versioning is present and no breaking change ships inside a published version.
checks.evidence_required: The version marker (path, header or media type) and a diff review showing no breaking change in a shipped version.
checks.how_to_run: Read the routes and the contract diff against the last published version.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Explicit versioning present; no breaking change inside a shipped version.

checks.claim: Unsafe retryable writes are idempotent; safe methods are genuinely idempotent.
checks.evidence_required: A test where a replayed create with the same Idempotency-Key does not double-write.
checks.how_to_run: Run the replay test and quote the single resulting record.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Idempotency on unsafe retryable writes; safe methods are genuinely idempotent.

checks.claim: Rate limiting returns 429 + Retry-After and list endpoints paginate.
checks.evidence_required: A test where an over-limit client gets 429 with Retry-After, and a list endpoint response with pagination.
checks.how_to_run: Run the rate-limit and pagination tests and quote them.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Rate limiting returns 429 + Retry-After; list endpoints paginate

checks.claim: No secrets in responses, error bodies or logs.
checks.evidence_required: A search of the diff, error handlers and log calls for secrets, with no hits.
checks.how_to_run: git diff plus a search for secret patterns; read the error envelope code.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: no secrets in responses or logs

checks.claim: Contract tests cover the happy path, auth failure and validation failure, not just 200.
checks.evidence_required: Test output listing all three kinds of case.
checks.how_to_run: Run the contract test suite and quote the case names and the exit code.
checks.honesty_note: Contract tooling is opt-in: when the contract tests did not run, mark NOT_RUN.

source.quote: Contract tests cover the happy path AND auth-failure AND validation-failure
